mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Jack In The Box</titleLeft><mainText>This unit will attack nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Deceive Attack</titleLeft><mainText>Shaco's next basic attack deals bonus damage and reduces the cooldown of Deceive.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shaco commands his clone to move to target location or attack target enemy.

This clone lasts up to @Spell.Jade_ShacoHallucinateFull:CloneLifetime@ seconds and detonates when it dies, dealing @Spell.Jade_ShacoHallucinateFull:ExplosionTotalDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies.

Clone deals @Spell.Jade_ShacoHallucinateFull:CloneAADamagePercent*100@% of Shaco's damage and receives @Spell.Jade_ShacoHallucinateFull:CloneIncomingDamagePercent*100@% increased damage.

The clone can also be controlled by holding the Alt key and using the right mouse button.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Jack In The Box</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Movement Speed is reduced, and is fleeing.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

BackstabShaco's basic attack critically strikes for @f1@% (+@f4@) damage when striking a unit from behind (@f3@% to Monsters).

Enemies can't be Backstabbed more than once every @f2@ seconds. This cooldown is modified by Cooldown Reduction.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shaco deals 20% bonus damage when striking a unit from behind.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Shaco deals 20% bonus damage when attacking from behind.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Deceive</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is invisible, and his next basic attack will critically strike.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shaco becomes invisible and teleports to target location. His next attack is guaranteed to critically strike.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shaco teleports nearby and becomes Invisible for 3.5 seconds.

His next basic attack within the next @EnhancedAttackDuration@ seconds will critically strike for @ModifiedQCritDamageTooltip@ damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies. Upon death, it explodes, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shaco vanishes briefly and reappears with a clone that lasts up to @CloneLifetime@ seconds. The clone deals @CloneAADamagePercent*100@% of Shaco's damage and receives @Jade_ShacoDamageTakenTooltip*100@% increased damage.

On death, the clone detonates, dealing @ExplosionTotalDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>The clone can be controlled using the Alt key and right click, or by <recast>Recasting</recast> this Ability.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Jack In The Box</titleLeft><mainText>This unit will attack nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shaco creates an animated Jack-in-the-Box at target location, which will wait, invisible, to Fear nearby units and attack them when some come nearby.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Shaco creates a trap that becomes Invisible after @StealthTImer@ seconds and lasts for @TrapDuration@ seconds. It activates when an enemy comes near Fearing nearby enemies for @FearDuration@ seconds.

Once activated, the trap fires at nearby enemies for @TrapTriggeredLifetime@ seconds, dealing @BoxTotalDamage_Jade@ magic damage.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Two-Shiv Poison</titleLeft><mainText>This unit's Movement Speed is reduced, If this unit is a minion, it has a chance to miss its attacks. </mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing them and applying a miss chance to minions. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: While this Ability is off Cooldown, Shaco's Attacks Slow the target by @SlowAmount*-100@% for @SlowDurationPassive@ seconds. Also reduces minions' chance to hit by @MissChance*100@% for @SlowDurationPassive@ seconds.

Active: Shaco throws a shiv, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to target enemy and Slowing by @SlowAmount*-100@% for @SlowDurationActive@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Trap Limit</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is limited to @f1@ active traps at a time. You currently have @f2@/@f1@ active traps (@f3@ remaining traps). Oldest trap will be removed when trap limit is exceeded.</mainText>
